answer: The willow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
